doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: FR34: System can track session progress (setup, execution, analysis, investigation, resolution). Sessions must be resumable with progress tracking for ongoing validation.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Session dataclass tracks validation metadata including id, created_at, strategy_name, status, and findings. Status uses Literal type for type-safe state management.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Sessions stored in YAML files for human-readability and version control. Session directory structure: validation-sessions/{session_id}/ with session.yaml, findings.yaml, logs/, analysis/.

artifact.reason: Existing Session dataclass to extend with stage tracking fields. Currently has status Literal but no SessionStage enum.
Reference for dataclass patterns and YAML serialization approach used in the codebase.
Core SessionManager class where update_stage() method will be added. Contains create_session, load_session, update_session, list_sessions methods.
Existing serialization logic showing how Session fields are converted to YAML. Must be updated to include new stage fields.
Pattern for success property and stage validation. ExecutionResult.success checks multiple conditions - similar pattern for stage transitions.
Current session list command that needs stage column added to table output format.
Existing test patterns for validation models. New stage tests should follow same structure.

constraints.constraint: Use Python Enum for SessionStage (not string literals) for type safety
Stage transitions must be atomic - always save session after stage change
Invalid stage transitions must raise ValueError with clear message
YAML serialization must handle Enum types (serialize to string value)
Follow existing SessionManager patterns for consistency
Stage field default must be SessionStage.CREATED

interface.name: SessionStage
interface.signature: class SessionStage(Enum): CREATED = "created", EXECUTING = "executing", EXECUTED = "executed", COMPARING = "comparing", COMPARED = "compared", INVESTIGATING = "investigating", COMPLETED = "completed", FAILED = "failed"

interface.name: SessionManager.update_stage
interface.signature: def update_stage(self, session: Session, stage: SessionStage) -> None

interface.name: Session model fields
interface.signature: stage: SessionStage = SessionStage.CREATED, stage_started_at: Optional[datetime] = None, execution_completed_at: Optional[datetime] = None, comparison_completed_at: Optional[datetime] = None, layers_completed: list[str] = field(default_factory=list)

tests.standards: Use pytest with descriptive test names following test_{what}_{condition} pattern. Tests should verify both happy path and error conditions. Use fixtures from conftest.py for session setup.
